headline_cpi_monthly_relative.provider: National Statistics Committee of Uzbekistan / SIAT

headline_cpi_detailed_crosscheck.provider: National Statistics Committee of Uzbekistan / SIAT

policy_rate_events.provider: Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan

transformations.headline_cpi_index: chain monthly official price relatives with 2020M12 normalized to 100
transformations.quarterly_inflation: year-on-year percent change in the arithmetic mean of three monthly chained index levels
transformations.quarterly_policy_rate_primary: calendar-day-weighted mean of official event rates
transformations.ex_post_real_policy_rate: calendar-day-weighted policy rate minus quarterly headline CPI year-on-year inflation
transformations.real_rate_deviation: current ex-post real rate minus strictly prior four-quarter mean

semantic_guards: ex-post real policy rate is not an expectations-based real rate
trailing real-rate deviation is not a structural neutral-rate gap
calendar-day average and quarter-end policy rates must remain separately named
